emily: Quick check — we still on track to onboard 'emerald-lite' for catalog launch? Need licensing sign-off + perf profile by EOD Fri. cc @raj @marta :eyes:
raj: I ran evals on quantized fp16->int8 run. Bulk numbers look fine. avg latency 28ms (p50) on T4, p95 75ms. accuracy drop ~0.8% on eval set.
marta: Legal says license is Apache-2.0 per model card. I already pinged OSS counsel; they want a model card + provenance file and explicit dataset checklist. I can add a checklist in the PR.
emily: Thanks — can we get a perf profile uploaded to the model manifest? We need runtime_shape and token_batch heuristics (so the serving runtime picks the right kernels).
owen: I can own the canary + routing policy. Tiny blocker: tokenizer differences — token counts for a few common prompts are off. Filed ticket #3421 and will open a patch PR today.
raj: Eval command I used:
```bash
python tools/eval_run.py --model 'emerald-lite' --batch 8 --dataset weave-val
```
Got 18 failing samples because of emoji tokenization edgecases. Working on sanitizer.
sarah-ci: deploy-bot: Staging smoke failed for model-ingest job 983 — HTTP 504 while pulling artifact. Retrying in 5m.
emily: Plan: marta to finish model card + provenance by Thu AM; raj to land tokenizer patch + perf profile by Thu EOD; owen to prep canary routing and smoke on Fri AM. If anything blocks, ping me directly in DMs or drop a note here.
marta: I'll add the checklist to the PR and tag @oss-counsel. Also attaching required provenance template in the PR description. :thumbsup:
owen: I'll draft the canary playbook and include rollback triggers (latency >250ms or qa-fail rate >2%). Will validate on staging once raj's patch lands. :shipit:
raj: Quick add — with int8 quant we should gate on a small chat-style eval (LLM instruction prompts) not only perplexity. I'll spin up a 200-sample chat QA set tomorrow.
emily: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update the catalog launch board (project/curation) after PRs land and move emerald-lite to 'preflight ready'. Closing the loop here.
